verdict.rationale: First-party docs show that a workspace administrator can control access to ChatGPT Work, plugins, browser use, and network access. The enterprise GPT sharing docs also show admin-style permissioning of approved workspace apps and permitted third-party APIs, so the permissions part of the story is directly evidenced. The data-controls mention is user-facing and not clearly an org policy; missing for 10: member management (invite/remove/roles), admin-set org data and retention policies, depth of admin console documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace

citations.quote: Your workspace administrator can control access to ChatGPT Work, plugins, browser use, and network access.
Allow GPT builders to use approved workspace apps or configure actions that interact with permitted third-party APIs.
Your ChatGPT data controls apply to content processed through ChatGPT, including screenshots taken by Computer Use.
